newsitem.title: CHINA: China jobless rate 2.98 percent at end-Sept.
newsitem.headline: China jobless rate 2.98 percent at end-Sept.

text.p: China's urban unemployment rate was 2.98 percent at the end of September, State Statistical Bureau spokesman Ye Zhen said on Wednesday.
The number of unemployed in Chinese cities reached 5.3 million, Ye told a news conference. He gave no comparative figures.
Ye said the figure did not include temporarily laid off workers at state enterprises. He gave no further details.

China's urban jobless rate was 2.9 percent by the end of June. The urban unemployment rate for 1995 was also 2.9 percent, but official media have warned the the figure could shoot up to 7.4 percent by 2000.

China aims to curb its jobless rate to 3.2 percent in 1996 to maintain social stability and economic growth as redundancies from state firms that once guaranteed jobs for life swell the ranks of unemployed.
